title: England at the World Cup
description: 1966 and all that — England's World Cup highs and heartbreaks.

questions.q: In which year did England win the World Cup?
questions.explain: England won on home soil in 1966.

questions.q: Who scored a hat-trick in the 1966 final against West Germany?
questions.explain: Hurst's three goals secured a 4–2 win after extra time.

questions.q: Who captained England to the 1966 title?
questions.explain: Bobby Moore lifted the Jules Rimet trophy.

questions.q: England lost the 1990 semi-final to West Germany how?
questions.explain: West Germany won the shootout after a 1–1 draw.

questions.q: Who won the Golden Boot at the 2018 World Cup with six goals?
questions.explain: Harry Kane top-scored as England reached the semi-finals.

questions.q: England were knocked out of the 2018 semi-final by which team?
questions.explain: Croatia came from behind to win 2–1 in extra time.

questions.q: Which England striker won the Golden Boot at the 1986 World Cup?
questions.explain: Lineker scored six goals in Mexico 1986.

questions.q: Whose tears in the 1990 semi-final became an iconic image?
questions.explain: Gascoigne cried after a booking that would have ruled him out of the final.

questions.q: Geoff Hurst's controversial second goal in the 1966 final — what was disputed?
questions.explain: Hurst's shot hit the crossbar and bounced down. The linesman ruled it had crossed the line, but the debate continues more than 50 years on.

questions.q: Who was England manager when they reached the 2018 World Cup semi-finals?
questions.explain: Gareth Southgate led England to the 2018 semi-finals in Russia — their first semi-final appearance since 1990 — before losing to Croatia.
